learning_outcomes.text: Introduce and teach manufacturing methods to the student.
Enable the student to perform simple calculations related to processing time, chip removal, and sheet metal working.
Provide practical knowledge that can be used in workshop and internship studies.

syllabus_topics: Connection of manufacturing methods with other subjects. General characteristics.
Welding technique. Place of welding in industry, definition, classification.
Weldability. Gas fusion, electric arc, submerged arc, gas metal arc welding methods.
Thermal cutting. Welding defects and distortions.
Build-up welding. Resistance. Friction and other welding methods.

Casting technique (Definition of casting, its importance, advantages, thermal analysis, solidification technique, casting methods, sand mold casting methods, pattern and core making, molding, melting and casting, cleaning and control, other casting methods).

Plastic forming methods (Principles of plastic deformation, mechanical - physical and metallurgical principles, forging, rolling, extrusion, bar and wire drawing, pipe manufacturing, sheet metal working methods).
